messages:
ops-bot: Heads-up: CA-TOR2 (ca-tor2) will run a limited pilot for Dedicated Peregrine-P600 micro-pools (6x96GB) starting Mon 2026-08-10 09:00 EDT. Pilot notes below. :loud_sound:
cal: (product) Invite-only pilot. Targeting memory-heavy retrieval and multimodal models. Limited seats.
nora: (infra) HW notes: Peregrine-P600 has wide NVLink mesh. Added PCIe topology-aware allocator and larger KV-cache alignment. Benchmarks: ~10-15% throughput uplift on 64k context tests.
sam: (ops) Scheduling: enable a 36h reserved-priority window on open to stabilize latency for committed tenants. Weights: reserved=280, shared=70.
infra: config snippet:
```
pool: ca-tor2-peregrine-p600-pilot
node_type: peregrine-p600
mode: micro-hybrid
priority_window_secs: 129600  # 36h
fairshare_reserved: 280
fairshare_shared: 70
alert: capacity.peregrine.spill
```

billing-bot: Billing: pilot-only policy reduces minimum reservation to 5 days in CA-TOR2 for Peregrine pockets. Shared on-demand and reserved billing rules still apply.
sales-bot: Sales: offering 30-day pilot addendum for invited accounts. Capacity requests via Capacity Request Form in runbook.
cal: Ops actions: add capacity.peregrine.spill to oncall, push topology allocator to staging tonight, prod pre-open push at 02:00 EDT.
ops-bot: Docs & runbook (internal): https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/peregrine-p600-tor2-pilot - internal only. Report regressions in #eng-runtime and tag @nora/@sam. :eyes:
